title: Michael Whelan
description: Michael Whelan, one of the world's greatest fantasy artists, hooked up with the world's greatest fantasy filmmaker, George Lucas. The result is this contemplative portrait of Yoda, the Jedi Master (front). Whelan did a number of pencil studies (back) before painting the timeless portrait, used as the cover of a diary, "My Jedi Journal." (Collection of William Plumb.)
